intro.title: if runs code only when a test is true
intro.body: A condition ends with a colon and the body is indented. Use elif for another test and else for everything left over.

challenges.explanation: 4 leaves remainder 0, so the if branch runs.

challenges.prompt: Type the single character that must follow the condition.
challenges.explanation: Every if, elif, else, for and def line ends with a colon.

challenges.statement: If the if condition is false and there is no else, the program continues after the block.
challenges.explanation: The skipped block simply does not run; nothing crashes.

challenges.prompt: Find the line that will raise an error, then choose the fix.
challenges.explanation: The body of an if must be indented four spaces.

challenges.prompt: Arrange the lines into a working grade checker.
challenges.explanation: Set the value, test the high case, then fall back to the else branch.
